sections.title: Ask about hobbies
sections.content: Use simple questions with qué, qué haces and qué te gusta to ask about free-time activities.

sections.title: Questions about hobbies
rows: What do you do in your free time?
What do you do on Saturdays?

items.english: What do you do in your free time?

sections.content: Keep the question pattern together: ¿Qué haces...? and ¿Te gusta...? Use familiar vocabulary in the answers.
